mapper.select: SELECT id, name, owner_id, 0 AS unread_count FROM im_chat_group WHERE id = #{groupId}
SELECT id, name, owner_id, 0 AS unread_count FROM im_chat_group WHERE id = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id FROM im_group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY user_id
SELECT joined_after_id, last_read_id FROM im_group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_group_member (group_id, user_id, joined_after_id, last_read_id) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{cursor}, #{cursor})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) FROM im_group_message WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_group_message (group_id, sender_id, client_msg_id, body) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{senderId}, #{clientMsgId}, #{body}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_id, sender_id, client_msg_id, body, created_at FROM im_group_message WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND client_msg_id = #{clientMsgId}

SELECT id, group_id, sender_id, client_msg_id, body, created_at FROM im_group_message FORCE INDEX (idx_group_history) WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND id > GREATEST(#{joinedAfterId}, #{afterId}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM im_group_message WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND id = #{messageId} AND id > #{joinedAfterId}
mapper.update: UPDATE im_group_member SET last_read_id = GREATEST(last_read_id, #{messageId}) WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
